# MFX Interactive (MULTIFX)

> MFX Interactive Pvt. Ltd. (brand: MULTIFX), from the house of TAAZATV, is a Kolkata-based supplier of interactive touch screen displays, touch kiosks, digital standees, interactive flat panels, indoor and outdoor LED displays and AI kiosks, with installation, warranty and after-sales support across Kolkata, West Bengal and India.

- Address: 1, Shakespeare Sarani, 6th Floor, AC Market (Back Gate), Kolkata 700017, West Bengal, India
- Phone: +91 6292004104 · Email: info@mfxinteractive.com
- Hours: Monday–Friday 9:00 AM–6:00 PM, Saturday 10:00 AM–4:00 PM, Sunday closed
- Warranty: 12 months standard from shipment, up to 24 months on designated models
- Support: 24/7 online support; replies within 4 hours on working days, 12 hours on weekends
- Clients include ITC Hotels (ITC Sonar, ITC Royal Bengal), Ambuja Neotia, Radisson, Tata Tiscon, GRSE, JIS Group, Merlin Group, The Spring Club and Tutopia

## Key pages

- [Touch Screen Display Supplier in Kolkata](https://mfxinteractive.com/touch-screen-display-kolkata): overview of products, services and why customers choose MFX Interactive
- [Touch Screen Displays](https://mfxinteractive.com/touch-screen-display): standees (21.5"–75"), wall-mount displays, kiosks, interactive tables, digital easels and interactive flat panels (65"–86")
- [Indoor LED Displays](https://mfxinteractive.com/indoor-led): fine-pitch P2.5 LED walls
- [Outdoor LED Displays](https://mfxinteractive.com/outdoor-led): weatherproof P10 LED screens
- [Outdoor Digital Displays](https://mfxinteractive.com/outdoor-digital-displays): weatherproof 55" digital signage
- [AI Kiosks](https://mfxinteractive.com/ai-kiosks): smart retail kiosks with facial recognition and voice assistant
- [Our Work](https://mfxinteractive.com/our-work): installations for ITC Sonar, ITC Royal Bengal, The Spring Club, Tutopia, Merlin and Natural Group
